registration_limits: Public aggregate accuracies and primary model prices were inspected when selecting data. This is not prospective preregistration or a fresh model trial.
harness: mini-SWE-agent 2.0.0, published 2026-02-17 submissions, one attempt per task/model
features: problem_statement word TF-IDF 1-2grams min_df2 max_features5000 sublinear_tf

split.notes: Pre-task repository can recur in train/test. Cluster bootstrap sensitivity by repository; unseen-repository performance not established.

estimators.quality: LogisticRegression(C=1,solver=liblinear,max_iter=2000,random_state=1729); constant training prior if one class
estimators.cost: Ridge(alpha=1,solver=lsqr) on log1p published cost, clamp predicted dollars to >=0.000001

allocation: Rank scores within each held-out fold; select floor(fraction*fold_size) tasks. The known batch quota uses no heldout labels/costs, including indirect cross-fold training effects. Not an online per-arrival quota guarantee.
portfolio_policy: argmax predicted success probability - lambda*predicted task cost
oracle: For each task choose cheapest successful model when one succeeds, otherwise cheapest model; uses true heldout labels and costs and is never a deployable result.

cost.kind: upstream-reported estimated API inference dollars per complete task attempt

analysis.quality_test: one-sided95 lower quantile of paired resolution difference > -0.03
analysis.cost_test: one-sided95 upper quantile of paired mean-cost ratio < 0.75
analysis.qualification: Intervals conditional on fixed fitted OOF policies and public one-attempt outcomes; no familywise claim from selecting grid winners.

portfolio_secondary: Also apply identical utility grid to the subset tagged os_model=true by source metadata; this tag is not a model-license audit.
